maintenance_led.reason: Sells generic, specialty and biosimilar medicines (CREXONT, Brekiya) as pharmaceutical products, not repair, servicing or aftermarket work.

publicly_funded.reason: Generics and branded drugs reach patients mainly through wholesalers, pharmacies and commercial payers; AvKARE federal distribution is the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own generics, injectables, biosimilars and branded launches, with only occasional acquisitions such as AvKARE.

mission_critical.reason: Most revenue is generic drugs, which pharmacies and wholesalers can swap between suppliers on price; specialty brands are smaller.

notes: Payer mix (Medicare/Medicaid share) is not stated on the website; the publicly_funded answer relies on general knowledge of generics.
